name: BLS E-Services Limited
summary: BLS E-Services Limited, a technology enabled digital service company, provides assisted E-services and E-governance services in India. The company act as business correspondents to provide banking products and services on behalf of banks to people, such as opening savings, recurring deposit accounts, cash deposits, withdrawals, remittance, transfer, and bill collection services, etc; and value added services through BLS touchpoints, including PoS services, ticketing services, and assisted e-commerce services.
